## Design

### 2026-10-06 — Ive started working on my pcb!

**2.5h**

Ive started working on my pcb!
Im following the starry guide seen as im new to all of this nad im typing in little chunks when I do a section so each part is a recall made right after I finished it.

Schematic:
I downloaded kicad from the AUR aswell as the base libaries and then the files from the week one care package.
I found all the parts,placed them and then labbled them.

Firstly I learnt about how to use the power symbol system, and placed all the signs for ground,5v and 3.3v on the esp32 aswell as the no connect flags on all the other points.
Finally, I added the labels and finished wiring everything to have my finished esp32 which looks like this:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/owGBzvsT890SQJUmVJe2KkEYzt7cBP7W/cdb418d66ea4ac174aef82ed85487d75f942dcdb956e2f189ffb317feb873881.png)

Then,i chose to do both the 4 and 8 pin connector, starting with the GND on the 4 pin,followed by the 3.3v and the lables for SCL and SDA.
Then, I did the 8 pin connector,starting by putting the no connect flags on 5-8, adding my SDA then SCL lables on 4 and 3,and finally adding GND to 2 and 3.3v to 1 to have my end products of:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/owGBzvsT890SQJUmVJe2KkEYzt7cBP7W/c0c27ddd6b7f37395c8a3dcc2d45ae1c42535b347a97acea31ddc836e103c82f.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/owGBzvsT890SQJUmVJe2KkEYzt7cBP7W/e3cbada585407885321145f5ad6e97b05474da067b8d775163b79dc60c7b3b53.png)

Finally, I wired the DHT11 sensor, starting with the 3.3v at the top, then the data label on the right and the GND on the bottom.
Then I also added the resistor below the sensor,wiring the 3.3v and the DHT11 data below to have this:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/owGBzvsT890SQJUmVJe2KkEYzt7cBP7W/2bf0fe089742aac00ff4353c7815bf4440acc0d533fef2a3f3d416e594b89d25.png)

Finally,i ended the schematic with this:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/owGBzvsT890SQJUmVJe2KkEYzt7cBP7W/dfe809d39643e0b6c971397dd51ee2c79d7f7ccf9a06893c49593ca27311eb24.png)

Then I pressed the assign footprints button and followed the image on the guide to set all the footprints to these:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/owGBzvsT890SQJUmVJe2KkEYzt7cBP7W/3e3d4e270e66b18e5e27177c18ba7e633e04d11bba340f2565f4acc133023326.png)
This meant I finished my schematic fully (Hopefully) and im going to later move onto the next part.
